channel.title: Assay release desk
channel.description: New AI model releases and how their launch claims held up against independent measurement.

item.title: Gemini 4 Argon: 5 launch claims assayed
item.description: Google's launch claims for Gemini 4 Argon were checked against Claude Opus 5.5 using independent measurements. Result: 3 Hallmarked, 2 Fool's gold. Hallmarked: Leads rival frontier models on the Vals Index, ahead of Opus 5.5 Hallmarked: Ranks first on Zapier's AutomationBench at 51.3% Hallmarked: Half Opus 5.5's token price should mean about half the cost per task Fool's gold: The same saving, after the introductory price ends

item.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5: 2 launch claims assayed
item.description: Anthropic's launch claims for Claude Sonnet 5.5 were checked against Sonnet 5 using independent measurements. Result: 2 Fool's gold. Fool's gold: The same per-task saving, checked at max effort Fool's gold: Fewer output tokens per task, checked at max effort

item.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash: 1 launch claim assayed
item.description: Google's launch claims for Gemini 3.8 Flash were checked against 3.7 Flash using independent measurements. Result: 1 Fool's gold. Fool's gold: Completed more than three times as many tasks as 3.7 Flash

item.title: GPT-6 Sol and Luna: 2 launch claims assayed
item.description: OpenAI's launch claims for GPT-6 Sol and Luna were checked against GPT-5.6 using independent measurements. Result: 1 Hallmarked, 1 Plated. Hallmarked: GPT-6 Sol costs half as much as GPT-5.6 Sol Plated: GPT-6 Luna cuts prices by about half

item.title: Claude Opus 5.5: 5 launch claims assayed
item.description: Anthropic's launch claims for Claude Opus 5.5 were checked against Opus 5 using independent measurements. Result: 3 Hallmarked, 2 Fool's gold. Hallmarked: Costs about 40% less to run than Opus 5 on typical workloads at default effort Fool's gold: The same 40% saving, checked at max effort Hallmarked: Generates output more than 30% faster than Opus 5 Hallmarked: Uses fewer tokens per task (customer reports range from 20% to 66% fewer)
